SendMessageAPI@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sends a message to a window and does not return until the window procedure has processed it; returns the message-specific result.

AnyPopup@rapidq2.inc.desc: Indicates whether an owned, visible, top-level pop-up or overlapped window exists on the screen. Obsolete; provided only for compatibility with 16-bit Windows.

BringWindowToTop@rapidq2.inc.desc: Brings the specified window to the top of the Z order, activating it if it is a top-level window. Returns nonzero on success.

RegisterClassEx@rapidq2.inc.desc: Registers a window class (described by a WNDCLASSEX structure) for later use with CreateWindowEx. Returns a class atom, or zero on failure.

EnumChildWindows@rapidq2.inc.desc: Enumerates the child windows of a parent window by passing each child handle to an application-defined callback function together with lParam.

CreateWindowEx@rapidq2.inc.desc: Creates an overlapped, pop-up or child window with an extended window style, class, title, position, size, parent and menu. Returns the window handle, or 0 on failure.

DefMDIChildProc@rapidq2.inc.desc: Provides default processing for any window message that the window procedure of an MDI child window does not process.

GetClassName@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the name of the class to which the specified window belongs into a buffer. Returns the number of characters copied, or 0 on failure.

SetProp@rapidq2.inc.desc: Adds a new entry or changes an existing entry in the property list of a window, associating a string name with a handle/value. Returns nonzero on success.

GetProp@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves a data handle from the property list of a window by property name. Returns 0 if the property is not found.

GetClientRect@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the coordinates of a window's client area; left and top are 0, so right and bottom give the client width and height.

MoveWindow@rapidq2.inc.desc: Changes the position and dimensions of a window, optionally repainting it. Top-level windows are positioned in screen coordinates, child windows relative to the parent client area.

GetFocus@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns the handle of the window that has the keyboard focus, if it is attached to the calling thread's message queue; otherwise 0.

GetParent@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns the handle of the specified window's parent or owner window, or 0 if there is none.

GetWindowRect@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the bounding rectangle of a window in screen coordinates, including title bar and borders.

GetWindowText@rapidq2.inc.desc: Copies the text of a window's title bar (or a control's text) into a buffer. Returns the number of characters copied.

GetWindowTextLength@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns the length, in characters, of a window's title bar text or a control's text (not including the terminating null).

GetCapture@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns the handle of the window (in the current thread) that has captured the mouse, or 0 if none.

DrawEdge@rapidq2.inc.desc: Draws one or more edges of a rectangle in a device context using the specified edge type (raised, sunken, etc.) and border flags.

DrawFrameControl@rapidq2.inc.desc: Draws a frame control of the specified type and state (button, caption button, menu glyph, scroll bar part) in a rectangle.

DrawCaption@rapidq2.inc.desc: Draws a window caption (title bar) for the given window into a rectangle of a device context, according to uFlags.

IsIconic@rapidq2.inc.desc: Determines whether the specified window is minimized (iconic). Returns nonzero if it is.

IsWindowVisible@rapidq2.inc.desc: Determines the visibility state of a window (WS_VISIBLE style of it and its parents). Returns nonzero if visible.

IsZoomed@rapidq2.inc.desc: Determines whether a window is maximized. Returns nonzero if it is.

RemoveProp@rapidq2.inc.desc: Removes an entry from the property list of a window and returns the data handle that was associated with it.

ReleaseCapture@rapidq2.inc.desc: Releases the mouse capture from a window in the current thread and restores normal mouse input processing. Returns nonzero on success.

SetCapture@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sets the mouse capture to the specified window so it receives all mouse input; returns the handle of the window that previously had capture.

SetClassLong@rapidq2.inc.desc: Replaces a 32-bit value at the given offset in the extra class memory or a WNDCLASSEX field of the window's class. Returns the previous value.

SetFocus@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sets the keyboard focus to the specified window. Returns the handle of the window that previously had the focus.

SetParent@rapidq2.inc.desc: Changes the parent window of the specified child window. Returns the handle of the previous parent, or 0 on failure.

SetForegroundWindow@rapidq2.inc.desc: Brings the thread that created the window into the foreground and activates the window. Returns nonzero if successful.

SetWindowText@rapidq2.inc.desc: Changes the text of the window's title bar or, for a control, the text of the control. Returns nonzero on success.

SetLayeredWindowAttributes@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sets the opacity and/or transparency color key of a layered window (WS_EX_LAYERED). Returns nonzero on success.

ShowWindow@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sets the window's show state (hide, show, minimize, maximize, restore, etc.). Returns nonzero if the window was previously visible.

CallWindowProc@rapidq2.inc.desc: Passes message information to the specified window procedure; used to call the original procedure from a subclassing window procedure.

EnableWindow@rapidq2.inc.desc: Enables or disables mouse and keyboard input to the specified window or control. Returns nonzero if the window was previously disabled.

SetWindowPos@rapidq2.inc.desc: Changes the size, position and Z order of a window; the SWP_ flags select which of these are applied. Returns nonzero on success.

GetWindowLong@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves information about a window (style, extended style, window procedure, ID, user data, etc.) at the given offset (GWL_ constants).

SetWindowLong@rapidq2.inc.desc: Changes an attribute of a window (style, window procedure, user data, etc.) at the given offset and returns the previous value; often used for subclassing.

ClientToScreen@rapidq2.inc.desc: Converts the client-area coordinates of a point to screen coordinates. Returns nonzero on success.

DefWindowProc@rapidq2.inc.desc: Calls the default window procedure to provide default processing for any window messages that the application does not process.

DragAcceptFiles@rapidq2.inc.desc: Registers whether a window accepts dropped files; when enabled the window receives WM_DROPFILES messages.

DragFinish@rapidq2.inc.desc: Releases the memory that the system allocated for transferring file names during a drag-and-drop (the HDROP handle).

DragQueryFile@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the names of dropped files from an HDROP handle; with index 0xFFFFFFFF it returns the number of files dropped.

DragQueryPoint@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the mouse position, in client coordinates, at the time a file was dropped. Returns nonzero if the drop was in the client area.

Shell_NotifyIcon@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sends a message to the taskbar's notification area to add, modify or delete an icon (NOTIFYICONDATA). Returns nonzero on success.

ShellExecute@rapidq2.inc.desc: Performs an operation (open, print, explore, etc.) on a file, URL or program. Returns a value greater than 32 on success.

SetCursorPos@rapidq2.inc.desc: Moves the mouse cursor to the specified screen coordinates. Returns nonzero on success.

GetKeyState@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the status of a virtual key: high-order bit set if the key is down, low-order bit set if a toggle key (e.g. Caps Lock) is on.

AlphaBlend@rapidq2.inc.desc: Displays a bitmap with transparent or semitransparent pixels, blending a source rectangle into a destination DC using a BLENDFUNCTION.

CreateDC@rapidq2.inc.desc: Creates a device context for a device (such as a display or printer) by driver and device name. Returns the DC handle, or 0 on failure.

BitBlt@rapidq2.inc.desc: Performs a bit-block transfer of color data from a source device context rectangle to a destination DC using a raster operation code.

CreateCompatibleBitmap@rapidq2.inc.desc: Creates a bitmap compatible with the device associated with the specified device context, with the given width and height.

CreateCompatibleDC@rapidq2.inc.desc: Creates a memory device context compatible with the specified device; select a bitmap into it before drawing.

CreatePen@rapidq2.inc.desc: Creates a logical pen with the specified style, width and color. Returns the pen handle; delete it with DeleteObject when done.

CreateSolidBrush@rapidq2.inc.desc: Creates a logical brush with the specified solid color. Returns the brush handle; delete it with DeleteObject when done.

DeleteDC@rapidq2.inc.desc: Deletes the specified device context (one created with CreateDC or CreateCompatibleDC). Returns nonzero on success.

DeleteObject@rapidq2.inc.desc: Deletes a logical pen, brush, font, bitmap, region or palette and frees its system resources. Do not delete an object still selected into a DC.

Ellipse@rapidq2.inc.desc: Draws an ellipse bounded by the given rectangle, outlined with the current pen and filled with the current brush.

ExtFloodFill@rapidq2.inc.desc: Fills an area of the display surface with the current brush, either up to a border color or over a region of a given color.

GetDeviceCaps@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves device-specific information (e.g. resolution, color depth, pixels per inch) for the specified device context and index.

GetObject@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves information about a graphics object (bitmap, pen, brush, font, etc.) into a buffer, such as a BITMAP or LOGFONT structure.

GetCurrentObject@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves a handle to the currently selected object of the specified type (pen, brush, font, bitmap, palette) in a device context.

GetPixel@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the RGB color value of the pixel at the specified coordinates in a device context; returns CLR_INVALID if outside the clip region.

GetStockObject@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves a handle to one of the stock pens, brushes, fonts or palettes. Stock objects need not be deleted.

LineTo@rapidq2.inc.desc: Draws a line with the current pen from the current position up to, but not including, the specified point, and updates the current position.

MoveToEx@rapidq2.inc.desc: Updates the current position in a device context to the specified point, optionally returning the previous position.

PatBlt@rapidq2.inc.desc: Paints a rectangle using the brush currently selected into the device context, combined with the display using a raster operation.

Rectangle@rapidq2.inc.desc: Draws a rectangle outlined with the current pen and filled with the current brush.

RoundRect@rapidq2.inc.desc: Draws a rectangle with rounded corners (given corner ellipse width and height), outlined with the current pen and filled with the current brush.

SelectObject@rapidq2.inc.desc: Selects an object (pen, brush, font, bitmap, region) into a device context and returns the handle of the object it replaces.

SetROP2@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sets the current foreground mix mode (binary raster operation) used for pens and brush interiors. Returns the previous mode.

SetBkMode@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sets the background mix mode (OPAQUE or TRANSPARENT) used for text, hatched brushes and non-solid pens. Returns the previous mode.

StretchBlt@rapidq2.inc.desc: Copies a bitmap from a source rectangle into a destination rectangle, stretching or compressing it to fit, using a raster operation.

GetDesktopWindow@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns a handle to the desktop window, the window that covers the entire screen.

DrawIconEx@rapidq2.inc.desc: Draws an icon or cursor into a device context with the specified size, frame index and drawing flags.

LoadImage@rapidq2.inc.desc: Loads an icon, cursor, animated cursor or bitmap from a module resource or a file. Returns the image handle, or 0 on failure.

EnumDisplaySettings@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves information about one of the graphics modes of a display device into a DEVMODE structure; call with increasing index to list all modes.

ChangeDisplaySettings@rapidq2.inc.desc: Changes the settings of the default display device (resolution, color depth, frequency) to the mode given in a DEVMODE structure.

ExitWindowsEx@rapidq2.inc.desc: Logs off the interactive user, shuts down, or restarts the system. Shutdown requires the SE_SHUTDOWN_NAME privilege.

GetDC@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves a device context for the client area of a window (or the entire screen if hWnd is 0). Release it with ReleaseDC.

ReleaseDC@rapidq2.inc.desc: Releases a common device context obtained with GetDC or GetWindowDC. Returns 1 if released.

SetActiveWindow@rapidq2.inc.desc: Activates a top-level window attached to the calling thread's message queue. Returns the previously active window.

SystemParametersInfo@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves or sets one of the system-wide parameters (work area, wallpaper, desktop and UI settings), optionally updating the user profile.

RtlMoveMemory@rapidq2.inc.desc: Copies a block of memory from a source address to a destination address; the blocks may overlap. Documented as the MoveMemory macro.

SetPriorityClass@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sets the priority class of the specified process (e.g. NORMAL, HIGH, IDLE). Returns nonzero on success.

GetPriorityClass@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns the priority class of the specified process, or 0 on failure.

GetCurrentProcess@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns a pseudo handle for the current process; it does not need to be closed.

GetDriveType@rapidq2.inc.desc: Determines whether a disk drive is removable, fixed, CD-ROM, RAM disk or network drive, given its root path.

GetDiskFreeSpaceEx@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the total size, total free space and free space available to the caller on a disk volume, as 64-bit byte counts.

GetSysColor@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the current color of the specified display element (COLOR_ index) as an RGB value.

GetMenu@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns a handle to the menu assigned to the specified window, or 0 if it has none.

GetMenuItemInfo@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves information about a menu item, by position or command ID, into a MENUITEMINFO structure.

SetMenuItemInfo@rapidq2.inc.desc: Changes information about a menu item (text, state, bitmap, submenu, etc.) using a MENUITEMINFO structure.

InsertMenuItem@rapidq2.inc.desc: Inserts a new menu item at the specified position in a menu, described by a MENUITEMINFO structure.

ModifyMenu@rapidq2.inc.desc: Changes an existing menu item's content, flags and identifier. Superseded by SetMenuItemInfo.

GetSaveFileName@rapidq2.inc.desc: Displays the common Save As dialog box, described by an OPENFILENAME structure. Returns nonzero if the user selected a file name.

GetOpenFileName@rapidq2.inc.desc: Displays the common Open dialog box, described by an OPENFILENAME structure. Returns nonzero if the user selected a file.

CommDlgExtendedError@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns a common dialog box error code for the last common dialog function call, or 0 if the user cancelled or no error occurred.

SLEEP@rapidq2.inc.desc: Suspends execution of the current thread for at least the specified number of milliseconds.

SetLastError@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sets the last-error code for the calling thread.

WSAGetLastError@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns the error status for the last Windows Sockets operation that failed in the calling thread.

GetLastError@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the calling thread's last-error code value.

FormatMessage@rapidq2.inc.desc: Formats a message string from a message table or a string, for example to get the text of a system error code from GetLastError.

SetupComm@rapidq2.inc.desc: Initializes the communications parameters of a serial device, setting the recommended sizes of the input and output buffers.

PurgeComm@rapidq2.inc.desc: Discards all characters from the output or input buffer of a communications device and can abort pending read/write operations.

SetCommTimeouts@rapidq2.inc.desc: Sets the time-out parameters (COMMTIMEOUTS) for all read and write operations on a communications device.

GetCommState@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the current control settings (baud rate, parity, etc.) of a communications device into a DCB structure.

SetCommState@rapidq2.inc.desc: Configures a communications device according to a DCB structure (baud rate, byte size, parity, stop bits, flow control).

ClearCommError@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves information about a communications error, reports the device's current status (COMSTAT) and clears the error flag.

CreateFile@rapidq2.inc.desc: Creates or opens a file or I/O device (file, directory, COM port, pipe, volume, etc.). Returns a handle, or INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE (-1) on failure.

WriteFile@rapidq2.inc.desc: Writes data from a buffer to the specified file or I/O device; the number of bytes written is returned through a parameter.

WriteFileAlias2@rapidq2.inc.desc: Writes data from a buffer to the specified file or I/O device; the number of bytes written is returned through a parameter.

ReadFile@rapidq2.inc.desc: Reads data from the specified file or I/O device into a buffer; the number of bytes read is returned through a parameter.

ReadFileAlias2@rapidq2.inc.desc: Reads data from the specified file or I/O device into a buffer; the number of bytes read is returned through a parameter.

CloseHandle@rapidq2.inc.desc: Closes an open object handle (file, device, process, thread, event, etc.). Returns nonzero on success.

ReadFileEx@rapidq2.inc.desc: Reads data from a file or I/O device asynchronously and calls a completion routine when the read finishes and the thread is in an alertable wait.

GetVersionEx@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves information about the operating system version into an OSVERSIONINFO structure. Deprecated since Windows 8.1 (results may be manifest-dependent).

GetSystemPowerStatus@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the power status of the system: AC or battery power, battery charge and remaining battery life.

SetSystemPowerState@rapidq2.inc.desc: Suspends the system by shutting power down (sleep or hibernate). Not supported on newer Windows; use SetSuspendState instead.

SetSuspendState@rapidq2.inc.desc: Suspends the system by shutting power down: hibernates if Hibernate is nonzero, otherwise sleeps. Returns nonzero on success.

GlobalMemoryStatus@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves information about the system's current physical and virtual memory usage. Use GlobalMemoryStatusEx for more than 4 GB.

GetSystemMetrics@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the specified system metric or configuration setting (screen size, border widths, etc.) by SM_ index.

OpenProcessToken@rapidq2.inc.desc: Opens the access token associated with a process, for example to adjust its privileges. Returns nonzero on success.

LookupPrivilegeValue@rapidq2.inc.desc: Retrieves the locally unique identifier (LUID) that represents the named privilege (e.g. SeShutdownPrivilege) on a system.

AdjustTokenPrivileges@rapidq2.inc.desc: Enables or disables privileges in the specified access token; requires TOKEN_ADJUST_PRIVILEGES access.

LoadLibrary@rapidq2.inc.desc: Loads the specified DLL or executable module into the calling process. Returns a module handle, or 0 on failure.

NViewSetLanguage@rapidq2.inc.desc: From nviewlib.dll: sets the language used by the NView image library (per the source comment, a JPEG/GIF loading DLL by K. Nishita).

NViewLoad@rapidq2.inc.desc: From nviewlib.dll: loads a JPEG or GIF image file (format detected from file contents, not extension) and returns a bitmap handle.

NViewGetHeight@rapidq2.inc.desc: From nviewlib.dll: returns the height of the image last loaded with NViewLoad.

NViewGetWidth@rapidq2.inc.desc: From nviewlib.dll: returns the width of the image last loaded with NViewLoad.

NViewSaveAsJPG@rapidq2.inc.desc: From nviewlib.dll: saves the current image as a JPEG file with the given quality.

JpegDLL_LoadImageFile@rapidq2.inc.desc: From jpeg.dll: loads an image file for the given window and returns an image handle.

JpegDLL_ImageHeight@rapidq2.inc.desc: From jpeg.dll: returns the height of an image loaded with LoadImageFile.

JpegDLL_ImageWidth@rapidq2.inc.desc: From jpeg.dll: returns the width of an image loaded with LoadImageFile.

FWCB_GetProcessHeap@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns a handle to the default heap of the calling process.

FWCB_HeapAlloc@rapidq2.inc.desc: Allocates a block of memory from the specified heap. Returns a pointer to the block, or 0 on failure.

PageSetupDlg@rapidq2.inc.desc: Displays the common Page Setup dialog box (PAGESETUPDLG) for setting paper size, orientation and margins. Returns nonzero on OK.

gRQ2_GetVersion@rapidq2.inc.desc: Returns the operating system version number (major/minor in the low word, build in the high word). Deprecated; use version helper functions instead.

gRQ2_Beep@rapidq2.inc.desc: Generates simple tones on the speaker with the given frequency (Hz) and duration (ms). The function is synchronous.

WaitForSingleObject@rapidq.inc.desc: Waits until the specified object (process, thread, event, mutex, etc.) is signaled or the time-out interval elapses.

CharToOem@conversion.inc.desc: Translates a string from the ANSI character set into the OEM-defined character set.

OemToChar@conversion.inc.desc: Translates a string from the OEM-defined character set into an ANSI character string.

CharLower@conversion.inc.desc: Converts a character string or a single character to lowercase, in place.

CharUpper@conversion.inc.desc: Converts a character string or a single character to uppercase, in place.

MultiByteToWideChar@conversion.inc.desc: Maps a character string in a given code page to a UTF-16 (wide character) string. Returns the number of characters written or required.

WideCharToMultiByte@conversion.inc.desc: Maps a UTF-16 (wide character) string to a new character string in the specified code page. Returns the number of bytes written or required.

MultiByteToWideChar1@conversion.inc.desc: Maps a character string in a given code page to a UTF-16 (wide character) string. Returns the number of characters written or required.

WideCharToMultiByte1@conversion.inc.desc: Maps a UTF-16 (wide character) string to a new character string in the specified code page. Returns the number of bytes written or required.

GetFileAttributes@Files.inc.desc: Retrieves file system attributes (read-only, hidden, directory, etc.) for a file or directory. Returns INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES (-1) on failure.

SetFileAttributes@Files.inc.desc: Sets the attributes (read-only, hidden, system, archive, etc.) of a file or directory. Returns nonzero on success.

CreateDirectory@Files.inc.desc: Creates a new directory (only the last path component). Returns nonzero on success.

InternetOpen@Files.inc.desc: Initializes an application's use of the WinINet functions and returns a root Internet handle.

InternetCloseHandle@Files.inc.desc: Closes a single Internet handle opened by WinINet functions.

InternetReadFile@Files.inc.desc: Reads data from a handle opened by InternetOpenUrl, FtpOpenFile or HttpOpenRequest; bytes read of 0 means end of data.

InternetOpenUrl@Files.inc.desc: Opens a resource specified by a complete FTP or HTTP URL and returns a handle for reading it with InternetReadFile.

SetWindowLongAPI@rapidq.inc.desc: Changes an attribute of a window (style, window procedure, user data, etc.) at the given offset and returns the previous value; often used for subclassing.

CreateCompatibleBitmap_AMIB@AddMenuItemB.desc: Creates a bitmap compatible with the device associated with the specified device context, with the given width and height.

CreateCompatibleDC_AMIB@AddMenuItemBitma.desc: Creates a memory device context compatible with the specified device; select a bitmap into it before drawing.

DeleteDC_AMIB@AddMenuItemBitmaps4a.inc.desc: Deletes the specified device context (one created with CreateDC or CreateCompatibleDC). Returns nonzero on success.

DeleteObject_AMIB@AddMenuItemBitmaps4a.i.desc: Deletes a logical pen, brush, font, bitmap, region or palette and frees its system resources. Do not delete an object still selected into a DC.

SelectObject_AMIB@AddMenuItemBitmaps4a.i.desc: Selects an object (pen, brush, font, bitmap, region) into a device context and returns the handle of the object it replaces.

SetBkMode_AMIB@AddMenuItemBitmaps4a.inc.desc: Sets the background mix mode (OPAQUE or TRANSPARENT) used for text, hatched brushes and non-solid pens. Returns the previous mode.

GetSystemMetrics_AMIB@AddMenuItemBitmaps.desc: Retrieves the specified system metric or configuration setting (screen size, border widths, etc.) by SM_ index.

PatBlt_AMIB@AddMenuItemBitmaps4a.inc.desc: Paints a rectangle using the brush currently selected into the device context, combined with the display using a raster operation.

TransparentBlt_AMIB@AddMenuItemBitmaps4a.desc: Performs a bit-block transfer from a source DC to a destination DC, treating pixels of the given color as transparent; can stretch.

SetMenuItemBitmaps_AMIB@AddMenuItemBitma.desc: Associates the specified bitmaps with a menu item, displayed next to the item depending on whether it is checked or unchecked.

GetUserName@AdvAPI32.inc.desc: Retrieves the name of the user associated with the current thread into a buffer. Returns nonzero on success.

GetDateFormat@ApiDate.inc.desc: Formats a date as a date string for a specified locale, using a format picture or locale defaults.

GetLocaleInfo@ApiDate.inc.desc: Retrieves information about a locale (e.g. date format, decimal separator, language name) specified by an LCTYPE value.

NWP_GetProcessHeap@NewWndProc.Inc.desc: Returns a handle to the default heap of the calling process.

NWP_HeapAlloc@NewWndProc.Inc.desc: Allocates a block of memory from the specified heap. Returns a pointer to the block, or 0 on failure.

NWP_SetWindowLong@NewWndProc.Inc.desc: Changes an attribute of a window (style, window procedure, user data, etc.) at the given offset and returns the previous value; often used for subclassing.

InitCommonControls@CommCtrl.inc.desc: Registers and initializes the common control window classes. Obsolete; new applications should use InitCommonControlsEx.

CreateStatusWindow@commctrl32.inc.desc: Creates a status window, typically displayed at the bottom of the parent window. Deprecated; use CreateWindow with STATUSCLASSNAME.

CreateUpDownControl@commctrl32.inc.desc: Creates an up-down control with the given style, position, buddy window, range and position. Deprecated; use CreateWindow with UPDOWN_CLASS.

DestroyPropertySheetPage@commctrl32.inc.desc: Destroys a property sheet page created with CreatePropertySheetPage; needed only for pages not passed to PropertySheet.

DrawInsert@commctrl32.inc.desc: Draws the insert icon in the parent window of a drag list box at the position of the specified item.

DrawStatusText@commctrl32.inc.desc: Draws the specified text in the style of a status window with borders, inside a rectangle of a device context.

FlatSB_EnableScrollBar@commctrl32.inc.desc: Enables or disables one or both flat scroll bar direction buttons.

FlatSB_GetScrollPos@commctrl32.inc.desc: Gets the thumb position in a flat scroll bar.

FlatSB_GetScrollProp@commctrl32.inc.desc: Retrieves a property (colors, sizes, style) of a flat scroll bar.

FlatSB_GetScrollRange@commctrl32.inc.desc: Gets the scroll range (minimum and maximum) of a flat scroll bar.

FlatSB_SetScrollInfo@commctrl32.inc.desc: Sets the information (range, page size, position) for a flat scroll bar using a SCROLLINFO structure.

FlatSB_SetScrollPos@commctrl32.inc.desc: Sets the current thumb position in a flat scroll bar, optionally redrawing it. Returns the previous position.

FlatSB_SetScrollRange@commctrl32.inc.desc: Sets the scroll range (minimum and maximum) of a flat scroll bar.

FlatSB_ShowScrollBar@commctrl32.inc.desc: Shows or hides a flat scroll bar.

GetEffectiveClientRect@commctrl32.inc.desc: Calculates the dimensions of a rectangle in the client area that excludes the specified visible controls (e.g. status bar, toolbar).

GetMUILanguage@commctrl32.inc.desc: Gets the language currently in use by the common controls for a particular process (set by InitMUILanguage).

ImageList_Add@commctrl32.inc.desc: Adds an image or images, with an optional mask bitmap, to an image list. Returns the index of the first new image, or -1.

ImageList_AddMasked@commctrl32.inc.desc: Adds an image to an image list, generating a mask from the specified color treated as transparent. Returns the image index, or -1.

ImageList_BeginDrag@commctrl32.inc.desc: Begins dragging an image from an image list, creating a temporary drag image with the given hotspot.

ImageList_Copy@commctrl32.inc.desc: Copies or swaps images within an image list.

ImageList_Create@commctrl32.inc.desc: Creates a new image list with the given image size, flags (color depth, mask), initial count and growth. Returns the image list handle.

ImageList_Destroy@commctrl32.inc.desc: Destroys an image list. Returns nonzero on success.

ImageList_DragEnter@commctrl32.inc.desc: Displays the drag image at the specified position within the window and locks that window against updates.

ImageList_DragLeave@commctrl32.inc.desc: Unlocks the specified window and hides the drag image, allowing the window to be updated.

ImageList_DragMove@commctrl32.inc.desc: Moves the image that is being dragged during a drag-and-drop operation, usually in response to WM_MOUSEMOVE.
